name: Business Academy Aarhus
about: Business Academy Aarhus is a business academy (erhvervsakademi) in Viby, on the south side of Aarhus. Its one English-taught first degree is Multimedia Design, a two-year AP degree in web and interface design, front-end programming and AI tools, which ends with a ten-week internship. It is shorter than a bachelor's, and the academy's own Digital Concept Development top-up turns it into one in a further 18 months.
ibNotes: No page read for this institution mentions DP Course Results. The canonical Opportunities apply the national rule (ev-ufsn-ib-course-results): Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 in all six subjects and three at HL, give access to AP and professional bachelor programmes.

sources.title: Multimedia Design at Business Academy Aarhus is a two-year AP degree (120 ECTS plus 10 extra-curricular), taught entirely in English with an August start. It needs English C and either Mathematics C or Economics C, plus English B or an accepted test.
Business Academy Aarhus charges no tuition to EU/EEA students. Non-EU students pay EUR 6,000 per semester for Multimedia Design (EUR 24,000 for the programme), valid from 2026.

notes: Research notes kept for the record. The site renders the canonical records in data/institutions, data/programmes and data/opportunities, whose evidence is in data/evidence/dk-colleges.json.

Business Academy Aarhus takes a stricter view of the English requirement than its subject list suggests. The specific requirement is English C, but the language requirement is English B, which only an accepted test can replace.

programmes.name: Multimedia Design
programmes.degree: AP degree – academy profession, not a bachelor's
programmes.summary: A two-year academy profession (AP) degree in web and app design and front-end programming: UX and UI, JavaScript, React, content production and AI tools, ending with a 10-week internship. It is shorter than a bachelor's, and an 18-month top-up turns it into one. Needs English C and Maths or Economics at C level.
programmes.requirementsText: English at the Danish C-level. [...] And Mathematics at the Danish C-level. [...] Or Economics at the Danish C-level. [...] The language requirement is English at the Danish B-level (at least 210 hours during the last three years of their upper-secondary education). However, if you only fulfil the specific entry requirement of English at C level, then the language requirement can be satisfied with an English test.
extraRequirements: English at B level, or an accepted English test
